RuleMigration.Label: Remove Rule links
RuleMigration.Hint: The Layout no longer has its own Rule system. Replaces &Rule[Key]{Text} in your world and in unlocked compendiums (world and module) with the plain text. Use the Rules of the FFXIV system instead.

RuleMigration.Found: {links} Rule link(s) in {documents} document(s) will be replaced by their visible text:

RuleMigration.DeletePages: Also delete {count} leftover Rule page(s) from the removed Rule page type
RuleMigration.Backup: This changes your documents permanently. Make a backup first.
